ZONINGLOT ANDDEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT AGREEMENT made as of this  day of January 2011 (this “Agreement"), between CAPITAL REALTY, INC, a New York corporation, having an address at 48 West 33?d Street, New York, New York 10001 ("Seller"); and 38-46 WEST 33 STREET LLC,a New York NewYork,NewYork("Developer"). A 1003c RECITALS: A.Seller is the owner of certain land known by the street address 48 West 33rd Street, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lot 72 in Block 834 on the Tax Map of the hereto and made a part hereof,together with the improvements thereon (said land being herein referred to as “Seller's Land,” and said improvements, together with any permitted future replacements thereof or permitted modifications thereto,being herein referred to as“Seller's referred to as “Seller's Property"). B.Developer is the owner of certain land adjacent to Seller's Land known by the street address 38-46 West 33rd Street, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lot 69 in Block 834 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,County of NewYork,more particularly described inSchedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, togetherwith the existing improvements thereon (said land as same may be expanded or diminished by Developer, and together with any development rights appurtenant to properties directly or indirectly contiguous to said land or Seller's Property, collectively being herein referred to as “Developer's Land" and said improvements collectively being herein referred to as "Developer's Existing Building"). C.Developer may renovate Developer's Existing Building or construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new or renovated building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions theretowhether made byDeveloper or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred to as “Developer's Proposed Building" and Developer's Land and Developer's Proposed Building being herein referred to as “Developer's Property"). Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Developer's Property includes the development rights acquired from the owner of land adjacent to Developer's Land known by the street address 36 West 33rd Street, New York, New York also known as Tax Lot 66 in Block 834 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York which development rights together with Agreement dated November 1, 2007 between Developer and Shea Realty, Inc. and recorded in the Office of theNewYork City Register, NewYork County as document No.2007000568831. D.Seller and Developer wish to merge Developer's Property and Seller's Property into a single “zoning lot,”as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (as amended to date, the “Zoning Resolution") (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot") F:LH:Torkian36 Wes33rdSreeirRighus PurhusAGREEMENT OFPURCHASEAND S.LE014b doc 17

E.As used herein “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean certain rights, as determined by the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, whereby such zoning lot maybe developedby erecting thereon one or more structureswith FloorArea(assuch term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) determined by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the allowable Floor Area Ratio(as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) in that zoning district. As used herein“Excess Development Rights” shall mean all of the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Seller's Land in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the improvements located on Seller's Land on the date hereof, but expressly excludes Three Thousand Seven Hundred Twenty Four (3,724) square feet of Floor Area (the “Retained Development Rights") which shall be retained by Seller. For purposes of clarification, the term Excess Development Rights and the calculation thereof excludes the Retained Development Rights. The parties hereto agree that the Excess Development Rights constitute Twenty Thousand Six Hundred Ten (20,610) square feet of Floor Area. G. The parties hereto have been advised that on the date hereof Seller's Existing Building uses less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights that are permitted for development on Seller's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution,and that, therefore,Seller has available the Excess Development Rights that, under procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution, may be made available to permit the construction of Developer's Proposed Building with Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available. H. Seller wishes to sell in perpetuity to Developer, and Developer wishes to purchase, the Excess Development Rights in order that Developer's Proposed Building be permitted to have Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available and, in any event, that Developer shall be the owner of the Excess Development Rights. 1. The parties hereto (among others) have simultaneously herewith executed and delivered a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration"),which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the New York County Office of theRegister of The City of NewYorkwith respect to the Combined Zoning Lot. J.. Seller's Land is contiguous with Developer's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and Seller's Land and Developer's Land are all within a single block.
